component.name: Omapath
component.summary: The native file manager for Omarchy

description.p: Omapath is a fast, keyboard-first GTK4 file manager designed for Omarchy and Hyprland.

It provides Icons, Compact and Details views, tabs, split view, folders and terminal panels, drag-and-drop copy/move/link, safe local operations with undo, Quick Look, properties, archive actions, recursive and content search, removable devices and an external URI clipboard.
Nautilus-inspired integrations add Starred and Recent places, files from ~/Templates, executable user scripts and GIO server connections while retaining the Omarchy theme.
